notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. Governing documents for faculty leave are saved: CU System APS 5019 (Parental Leave for Faculty and University Staff, effective 2016-11-17, all campuses) and the Boulder Provost's parental leave memo (2007-08-28, version_uncertain). missing = false.
2018_05 holds no leave policy (links to Laws of the Regents Article 11 and the benefits website only).

V3c: the System APS 5019 leave (c1, 18 weeks, sick leave then half pay, guaranteed) and the campus Provost leave (c2, up to one semester at full pay, primary caregiver) are linked concurrent_with; the campus tenure-clock stop (c3) and the System stop (c4) likewise.

Entitlement of the campus leave (c2): the Provost's 2007 memo says 'may request' (no grant language; approval by Faculty Affairs; replacement funding 'as long as funding is still available'), which reads as discretionary under V2; the campus pages (2018_01, and the January 2018 tenure-clock policy 2018_02) say the faculty member 'will ... receive up to a maximum of one semester at full pay'. Read as guaranteed_on_request under V3d step 4: 2018_02 is the Boulder Campus Policy (revised January 2018), later than the memo. Flagged ambiguous.

U9: the System APS limits tenure-clock stops to two ('Absent extraordinary circumstances'); coded as use_limit on c3, c4, c5. The memo and campus pages restate it as 'a maximum of two parental leaves'; per U9's CU Boulder decision, no use_limit on the leave and c2 flagged conflicting_sources.

The memo's 'this one semester maximum includes all leave associated with the birth or adoption of the child' is not coded as a leave_limits entry (it would cut the System's guaranteed 18 weeks and the 32-week maximum); flagged ambiguous: restriction on c2.
leave_limits: APS II.D caps parental leave (standard, campus, unpaid and FMLA) at 32 weeks in total for 9-month faculty.

Calendar: semester calendar stated ('to coincide with the semester calendar', memo; tenure clock 'beginning each fall semester') with no length → calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Other paths (U8, notes only): nine-month instructors — the campus page says APS sick leave use 'up to a maximum of one semester' then half pay (APS itself gives other nine-month faculty the same 18 weeks as tenure-stream faculty); twelve-month tenure-stream faculty are eligible for the campus tenure-track parental leave (page) while APS gives twelve-month faculty the staff six months (c9). Research faculty and lecturers are referred elsewhere.

Not components: sabbaticals, leaves funded by other institutions, military leave, political-candidate leave, delaying or shortening the tenure clock at hire (no parent could use them for a birth or adoption).
